info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Banking Accounts Beneficiaries-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Beneficiaries Retrieval API enables users to access a list of beneficiaries linked to banking accounts. This API serves financial institutions and services that require efficient management and overview of account beneficiaries. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline the process of retrieving beneficiary information for various banking operations, ensuring quick access to essential data for customer support, compliance checks, and transaction facilitation. Integration of this API is ideal for applications focused on banking services and customer account management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of beneficiaries associated with accounts.
get.description: This endpoint allows the user to fetch all beneficiaries linked to specific accounts. Useful for managing and viewing beneficiary details efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a list of beneficiaries associated with the account. It allows the client to request detailed information regarding beneficiaries for operational processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of beneficiaries.
